paper.title: Bounded Recursive Self-Improvement
paper.central_claim: AERA (autocatalytic, endogenous, reflective architecture), seeded with a small amount of designer code, accumulates and prunes its own executable models from experience under value-driven scheduling, thereby achieving bounded recursive self-improvement; a prototype (S1) learned real-time multimodal dialogue by observation.

provenance.notes: actual_model/session_id/receipt_ref not exposed to the worker in this subagent context; model_type is the configured type only. Pre-LLM cognitive-architecture paper; treated as A-class only at the object-level (self-acquired executable models), not as harness-level LLM RSI.

signatures.object: memory of executable causal models (left-pattern -> right-pattern with guards) and composite states; baseline = designer-supplied seed (drives, top-level models, primitive commands, ontology)
signatures.information: sensory inputs (speech tokens with prosody, motion), own commands, internal traces (instantiated models, success/failure, performance measures); no labels or reward other than drives
signatures.operation: on unpredicted goal success or failed prediction a targeted pattern extractor buffers recent inputs, abstracts them into new models (guards = linear templates) with pre/post-condition models; prediction/goal monitors update model reliability
signatures.output: new models in memory, later abstracted or deleted
signatures.conditions: insufficient-knowledge-and-resources assumption; "time precedence indicates causality"; event-driven, surprise only
signatures.feedback: success/failure of predictions and goals against sensed events
signatures.selection_rule: low initial reliability; reliability = successes/(evidence+1); phase-out < THR1; delete < THR2; LRU garbage collection; priority by value-driven scheduling
signatures.selection_data: the live stream itself (no separate validation)
signatures.persistence: models and composite states in memory (thousands in deployed systems)
signatures.later_use: forward/backward chaining, planning and attention use models weighted by reliability and utility
signatures.claimed_effect: S1 learns two dialogue tasks by observation with 0 observed errors afterwards
signatures.failure_boundary: no hidden-cause learning; bounded by seed; thresholds unspecified; scalability unshown

signatures.object: the architecture's own control parameters (thresholds, drive priorities, garbage-collector threshold, compilation of model sequences)
signatures.operation: meta-system or the system itself raises thresholds or lowers drive priorities under congestion

gap.author_gap: Present engineering assumes well-defined environments and human-written code; systems cannot adapt, re-define missions or degrade gracefully when knowledge and resources are insufficient; formal RSI proposals (Godel Machine, AIXI) are unimplemented or intractable.
gap.checked_gap: The conceptual critique of GM/SOAR/LIDA/NARS is argued in Sec 7 but not tested; no empirical comparison with any of them or with a non-self-modifying variant.
lineage: Godel Machine / AIXI -> theoretical RSI with proofs
SOAR / LIDA -> cognitive architectures without goal-directed self-adaptation under resource limits
AERA -> add/remove small models from surprise, reliability-gated, value-scheduled
gap.residue: A running implementation that rewrites itself in small, experience-justified steps without proofs.
gap.stakes: Autonomy after leaving the lab, resource-bounded.
gap.method_response: Autocatalytic/endogenous/reflective architecture with reliability-gated model turnover.
gap.remaining_gap: Scalability and generality unshown; meta-control unused in experiments; learning only on surprise; no curiosity; participants and tasks narrow.
unresolved: Godel Machine/NARS/SOAR/LIDA originals are not pinned; comparison relies on Sec 7. AERA seed specification (RUTR-SCS13005) and implementation are external and not in the pinned material.

rs_pattern.reason: Core operations (surprise-triggered causal-model induction, reliability-gated model turnover, value-driven job scheduling, operational reflectivity) do not instantiate any of the 15 ideation patterns. Considered and rejected: unify_into_shared_representation (uniform term representation, but no borrowed recipe or shared embedding space as the contribution) and structural_prior_encoding (AER design principles are architecture requirements, not a known problem invariant). Paper is still evaluated fully.
rs_pattern.resolves_problem: partial: S1 learns two scripted dialogue tasks; bounded recursive self-improvement in general is not shown

assessment.strongest_supported_claim: In two scripted dialogue tasks with one dyad of developers, the AERA prototype acquired executable models from observation and, according to the authors' video inspection, performed without errors afterwards; nothing isolates the role of self-modification, and bounded recursive self-improvement in general is not demonstrated (authors defer scalability).
unresolved: No controls: evidence cannot be attributed to the retained models or gating rule.
Meta-level self-control implemented but unused in experiments.
Scope: non-LLM architecture; harness-level RSI interpretation is analogical.

G.reason: Clear and sourced position (insufficient knowledge and resources; no human-written code; unimplemented Godel Machine; SOAR/LIDA/NARS) and explicit remaining gaps (scalability, curiosity, observation-only learning). The bottleneck is argued conceptually, not measured, and nearest neighbours are not pinned.

M.reason: Object-level chain is coherent: surprise -> candidate models -> reliability-gated acceptance/retirement -> reuse by chaining and scheduling, justified against requirements R1-R9. The claimed recursion/meta-level improvement is not what the mechanism demonstrates, and "time precedence indicates causality" is a weak induction assumption.

X.reason: Equations for urgency, reliability, utility and priorities, program types, thresholds and abstraction are specified so the loop can be rebuilt; retention (low initial reliability, phase-out, deletion, LRU GC) and boundaries (limitations, bounded rewriting) are clear. Threshold values, seed specification and code are not in the paper, and meta-control is unexercised.

E.measurement.reason: Outcomes are judged by authors' inspection of recorded videos and t-pattern structure with no stated error definition, second rater, blinding or quantitative similarity measure; speech input restricted to 100 words; participants are developers.

E.causality.reason: No baseline, ablation, non-learning or ungoverned-store variant, or meta-control on/off comparison is reported; the only reference is human-human behaviour, which does not attribute the result to the self-modifying mechanism.
search_scope: keyword search of full text: baseline (0 hits), ablat (0), control group (0), trials (0), random seed (0)

E.holdout.reason: S1 is tested in later live interaction after observation, but with the same developer dyad, the same scripted topics and vocabulary; no held-out participants or situations and no leakage analysis. Generalisation is asserted rather than tested.

E.statistics.reason: Single run per experiment, one dyad; denominators (about 17 and 8000 turns) are given and the t-pattern analysis reports significance thresholds, but no repeats, error rates with intervals or failure analysis.

E.cost.reason: Observation time (about 2.5 minutes and 20 hours) is reported as data cost; computing resources, model counts, memory and scheduler load are not, and nothing is compared.
